claim: A palette bank laid out like the Next default ULA levels (1 black, 2-8 inks, 9-15 bright inks) lets a tile's palette offset select the cell ink, so no per-ink patterns are needed.
limit: Transparency of index 0 was not confirmed per emulator in the notes.

evidence.text: Tilemap palette bank 0: 0 transparent, 1 black, 2-8 inks 1-7, 9-15 bright inks; bank n is bank 0 with pixel 2 as ink n, so a one-ink tile's palette offset is the ink.
